messages:
Priya K: Quick sync — next week's release train (Tue 09:00 PT). Need owners for infra, runtime, console, and migrations. Who's taking what? Please add timing (start window) and smoke lead.
Ben L: I'll take runtime. Planning 09:00-09:30 PT slot. Smoke: I'll run smoke scripts and check per-route latency dashboards. Can we do a 10-min canary then full?
Marco: I'll do console. Slot 09:30-10:00 PT. Smoke lead: @Tina. Will coordinate feature flags.
Tina: Ack, I'll be smoke lead for console. What's the rollback plan? Need a quick toggle and db fallbacks?
Priya K: Rollback policy: immediate deploy rollback to previous container tag + feature flag off. Migrations must be backward-compatible or run in separate window. If DB change required, push to Wed slot.
Ben L: Runtime has a non-breaking KV index migration; it's safe. Deploy steps:
```
./deploy.sh --service=runtime --tag=canary-20240312
./smoke/run_runtime_smoke.sh --short
```
I'll watch traces and p95 latency. If >200ms for 3 mins, rollback.
Marco: Console deploy command:
```
kubectl set image deployment/console console=console:20240312 && ./ops/smoke-console.sh
```
Tina: I'll post smoke checklist before deploy and add monitoring playbook notes.
deploy-bot: Deploy slot reserved: Tue 09:00 PT - runtime (Ben L) | Tue 09:30 PT - console (Marco) | Reviewers: Priya K, Tina
Priya K: Thanks. Owners, please drop a short post when you start and when smoke passes including the dashboard links. If you need swap, ping here 30m in advance.
Tina: One request—keep canary to 10% traffic for 15m, then 100% if green. I'll coordinate the traffic switch.
Ben L: Got it. I'll set canary 10% and post metrics.
Marco: Confirmed. I'll be on call during my slot.
Priya K: Perfect — I'll be monitoring rollout and ready to coordinate rollback if anything pops. :thumbsup:
